On the positive note, the lady owner was friendly and they offer money changing service if needed.

More caring and training is needed in Tam Coc Wharf
Dec 2019
One lady working on Hoa Luan restaurant sold me a van ticket to come back to Hanoi. She put me on a car that I think would bring me to take the van. The driver was driving 100km/h on the road that goes from Tam Coc to Ninh Binh - NOT normal speed for that road- We just had an accident because we was driving so fast that either we crushed on the traffic sign or on the truck that was in front of us. So we crushed with both.
Not sure about Hoa Luan restaurant services, but trying to find a transport back to Hanoi on Tam Coc wharf was simply overwhelming. This is not a complaint about the restaurant that sold me the ticket, but about how tourists are treated as a flock of sheep in whole Tam Coc Wharf. It is not my first time in Tam Coc, and I always had same feeling. Too many travelers and very little training to tourism actors. With tourists safety is not nice to play and this is not good for tourism sector so corrective measures (basically proper training on different tourism services) are starting to be highly urgent. 
I am still trembling. This has spolit my stay in beautiful Ninh Binh. :(
